items.quote: we are confident as on today also that by June end, we may sign this contract
items.statement: QRSAM contract signing by June 2026 (5-10% chance of slipping to July)
items.speaker: Manoj Jain

items.quote: We will definitely give our first of production model within 18 months of signing the contract.
items.statement: First production model delivered within 18 months of contract signing
items.speaker: Manoj Jain

items.quote: we are expecting of the tune of INR2,000 crores to INR10,000 crores, somewhere in between
items.statement: Homegrown data-centre solution orders of INR2,000-10,000 crore once deal is clicked
items.speaker: Manoj Jain

items.quote: We wanted to steadily increase it to 15% to 20%.
items.statement: Non-defence business target of 15-20% (aspirational, over time; 8-10% today)
items.speaker: Manoj Jain

items.quote: We want to increase it to more than 10% of our turnover.
items.statement: Export share of turnover above 10% (4-5% today)
items.speaker: Manoj Jain

items.quote: But next 2 to 3 years, between 80% to 85% on an average indigenous content will be there for our products.
items.statement: Average indigenous content of 80-85% over next 2-3 years
items.speaker: Manoj Jain

items.quote: So definitely, we are going to have more than 15% as a revenue growth for '26-'27.
items.statement: FY27 revenue growth of more than 15%
items.speaker: Manoj Jain

items.quote: EBITDA margins will be more than 28%.
items.speaker: Manoj Jain

items.quote: The order inflow we are expecting this year more than INR55,000 crores.
items.statement: FY27 order inflow above INR55,000 crore, including QRSAM
items.speaker: Manoj Jain

items.quote: we are targeting more than INR1,200 crores as a capital investment for this year
items.speaker: Manoj Jain

items.quote: defense to non-defense ratio, more or less, it will be 90% to 10%, maybe plus/minus 1%
items.statement: FY27 defence to non-defence revenue mix of about 90:10 (+/-1%)
items.speaker: Manoj Jain

tone.label: confident
tone.why: Management reiterates FY27 guidance and says "we are confident as on today also" about near-term order timing, backed by stated planning.
